senses.gloss:
ind. 
__1 Like, as (showing उपमा or comparison); बागर्थाविव संपृक्तौ [[R. 1. 1]]; वैनतेय इव विनतानन्दनः [[K. 5.]] 
__2 As if, as it were (denoting उत्प्रेक्षा); पश्यामीव पिनाकिनम् [[Ś. 1. 6.]] लिम्पतीव तमोड्गानि वर्षतीवाञ्जनं नभः [[Mk. 1. 34.]] 
__3 Little, somewhat, perhaps; कडार इवायम् [[G. M.]] 
__4 (Added to interrogative words), ‘Possibly’, ‘I should like to know’, ‘indeed’; विना सीतादेव्या किमिव हि न दुःखं रघुपतेः [[U. 6. 30]]; क इव of what sort, what-like; क इव कालः [[Māl. 2]]; what a long time has elapsed. 
__5 इव is frequently used with adverbs, especially with such as involve restriction, by way of emphasis in the sense of even or just so, just, exactly, quite, indeed, very; मुहूर्तमिव but for a moment; किंचिदिव just a little bit; so ईषदिव, नाचिरादिव, &c.; (इव is considered by grammarians as forming compounds with the word after which it stands; इवेन समासो विभक्त्यलोपश्च Vārt. on [[P. II. 4. 71.]] [[Sk.]]). 
-Comp. 
-उपमा f. A simile in which इव is used. [[Bk. 10. 41]] is given as an illustration of इवोपमा.

a. 
__1 Going. 
__2 So large, so stately or magnificent.
